title: Minimum Spanning Tree Edge Indices
description: Given a connected undirected weighted graph, return the input indices of the edges in a minimum spanning tree. Kruskal’s algorithm must break equal-weight ties by smaller input index. Return selected indices in increasing input order.
hints: Sort candidate edges by weight and use a disjoint-set structure to track connected components.
Respect the stated tie-breaking rule and handle disconnected graphs if allowed.
